connection.title: Connect to your matrix
connection.description: Select the exact model. Setup reads its status without changing any routes.

reconfigure.title: Update matrix connection
reconfigure.description: Update the address of the same matrix while keeping its entities and names.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The matrix connection has been updated.

init.title: Source names
init.description: Optional names for the numbered matrix inputs. Leave a field blank to use its device label. Match your dashboard source values to the resulting names.
